$comment: Machine-readable parameters for the local unattended runners (design docs/designs/2026-09-26-runner-lock-retry-enforcement-design.md D3). Copy to .pipeline-state/runner-config.json (gitignored) to override. The runner prompts reference this file instead of restating numbers — change a limit here, not in a prompt. This committed example documents the current defaults.

governance_ticket_batch.escalation: tickets at/over the retry cap are reported by `bun scripts/ticket.ts doctor` and left for the next attended session; never force past the cap from an unattended run
